description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LocationDao component of the OrangeHRM system, testing various data retrieval and search methods related to locations.

classes.name: LocationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationDao methods, focusing on location retrieval, search, and associated data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating a new LocationDao instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a location by a valid ID and asserting its properties.

methods.name: testGetLocationByIdForNonExistingId
methods.description: Tests retrieving a location with a non-existing ID, expecting a null result.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Tests retrieving the number of employees for a specific location.

methods.name: testGetLocationList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of location IDs and verifies the count.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForNullArray
methods.description: Tests searching locations with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForLocationName
methods.description: Tests searching locations filtered by name.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCity
methods.description: Tests searching locations filtered by city.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCountry
methods.description: Tests searching locations filtered by country code.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Tests counting search results filtered by country.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Tests retrieving location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieving location IDs for a single employee.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesNoEmployees
methods.description: Tests behavior when no employee numbers are provided.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesEmployeesWithoutLocations
methods.description: Tests behavior when employees do not have associated locations.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesInvalidEmployees
methods.description: Tests behavior with invalid/non-existing employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetLocationsByIds
methods.description: Tests retrieving location entities by a list of IDs.
